title: NDI job record (job.json)
description: One long task, kept as <jobs root>/<id>/job.json, where <jobs root> is $NDI_JOBS_DIR or ~/.ndi/jobs. Shared by NDI-matlab (ndi.job.Job) and NDI-python. A reader that does not know a job's kind, or reads an older formatVersion than the file's, lists the job but must not run it. Other files in the job's folder: pause.request (present = a pause is requested; the runner removes it when it pauses or starts), and whatever the kind keeps there (for lightsheetToCloud: documents/<docid>.json, every document uploaded with its series member uids, and cache/).

id.description: Unique id; also the job's folder name.

kind.description: Language-neutral kind name, mapped to an implementation by each language's registry (e.g. 'lightsheetToCloud').

runtime.description: The language that made or last ran the job.

updated.description: Last time the record was written.

state.description: A job saved as 'running' whose process (host + pid) no longer exists is shown as 'interrupted'.

message.description: The latest word from the work.

lastError.description: Report of the error that failed the job; empty otherwise.

heartbeat.description: Last sign of life while running; empty before the first.

host.description: Computer the job last ran on; a pid is only meaningful there.

pid.description: Process running the job on host; 0 when none.

spec.description: What to do; defined by the kind, JSON-only values.

checkpoint.description: What is done so far; defined by the kind.

utc.description: UTC, ISO 8601, to the second, with Z.
